interpretation: Native 24/24 retain for 7s, 17/24 pass extra rest/drift/collision diagnostic, on both platforms. These are 24 development cases, not a 100-episode acceptance.
Manual candidate0 fails all seven placements on both runtimes. Candidate1 passes 5/7 on Linux and 6/7 on Mac; no optimization or selection after perturbation outcomes.
Native holds use actual v8 env.step, randomized parameters, control delay/bias and noisy/lost vision. Manual releases use nominal physical open-loop commands and are a separate diagnostic.
Native geometry audited at 20Hz; manual geometry audited every 2ms. Manual insertion is not simulated.
The 512-step smoke has 0/2 rotational success and zero drops; confirms integration, not learning.
Legacy deployment and job/curriculum wrappers still reject/use their v7 contract; v8 needs its explicit CLI, and an eventual accepted-policy deployment adapter.

Next experiment should learn grasp stabilization from physically reached pregrasp and separate manual release, with a separately versioned grasp objective/reset and bounded training supervision before regrasp/rotation.
